answer: Each AI agent must lock recurring stake and submit a weekly Intel SGX attestation whose unique sealing key is hashed into a public identity commitment; if two identities ever echo the same sealing key, the contract slashes both stakes. A sybil attacker must therefore provision one distinct SGX enclave per fake agent, so hardware plus attestation fees form a mesa of upfront cost, while duplicate identities bleed stake like yarrow spreading through each cloned key.
